question: What will be the remainder when 143 × 141 × 133 is divided by 6?
solution:
**Given:**

Number = 143 × 141 × 133

**Calculation:**

**(overset{5)/(overbrace{143)}times overset{3}{overbrace{141}}times overset{1}{overbrace{133}}}{6}**

Now multiply remainders and again divide by 6 

⇒ (5 x 3 x 1)/6 = 15/6

so, remainder = 3

**Hence, 3 will be the remainder when 143 × 141 × 133 is divided by 6.**
